page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading.

This instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No GPUs are bundled with this hardware profile.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, this instance offers a robust platform for memory-intensive workloads. The absence of hyperthreading and local storage represents a design tradeoff that prioritizes predictable compute performance and externalized storage management. It is suited for workloads such as in-memory databases, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio.
